dedupe_keys.name: mlit disaster prevention portal lifeline information links

description: This page of MLIT's disaster prevention portal gathers, in one place, links to the live outage and damage status pages of Japan's lifeline operators for use during disasters. It covers electricity, with outage information from the ten regional transmission and distribution companies from Hokkaido to Okinawa, gas and water, with the Agency for Natural Resources and Energy disaster page and the Japan Water Works Association link list, and telecommunications, with failure notices from NTT East, NTT West, NTT Communications, NTT Docomo, KDDI and SoftBank, each tagged by hazard type and region and offered in several languages. It is maintained by MLIT. The portal is available free on the MLIT website; no licence is named. Caveats: it is a directory of links, so the data themselves sit on each operator's page in varying formats, mostly as live notices, not downloadable archives. It supports near-real-time situational awareness of multi-sector lifeline outages in Japan; a related record is the Great East Japan Earthquake restoration data.
name: MLIT Disaster Prevention Portal, lifeline information links
